entity_type.description: One of: experiment, project, prompt, prompt_version, span, test_suite, test_suite_item, thread, trace.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

filters.description: OQL filter for trace, span, thread, experiment: <field>[.<key>] <op> <value> [AND ...]; ops = != > >= < <= contains not_contains starts_with ends_with is_empty is_not_empty in not_in; strings quoted, numbers bare (duration in ms). E.g. 'error_info is_not_empty AND duration > 5000', 'feedback_scores.accuracy < 0.5 AND start_time >= "2026-09-08T00:00:00Z"'. Reference: schema("list.trace").
filters.title: Filters

name.description: Optional substring filter on entity name. Supported for project, experiment, prompt, test_suite; ignored for sub-collections.
name.title: Name

project_id.description: Parent project UUID for project-scoped lists (trace, span, thread). Pass this OR project_name.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Parent project name — alternative to project_id for trace/span/thread lists, so you don't need to resolve the UUID first.
project_name.title: Project Name

prompt_id.description: Required when listing prompt_versions. UUID of the prompt.
prompt_id.title: Prompt Id

search.description: Free text for trace, span, thread: matches anywhere in id, name, input, output, metadata, tags, thread_id (spans: model, provider too).
search.title: Search

since.description: Start of the time window for trace, span, thread: a relative span ('30m', '1h', '24h', '7d') or an ISO-8601 instant with timezone. Windows are by record creation time; for an exact start_time bound use filters.
since.title: Since

sort.description: Sort for trace, span, thread, experiment: '<field> [asc|desc]', desc by default. E.g. 'duration desc', 'total_estimated_cost', 'feedback_scores.accuracy asc', 'usage.total_tokens'. One field only.
sort.title: Sort

test_suite_id.description: Required when listing test_suite_items. UUID of the suite.
test_suite_id.title: Test Suite Id

until.description: End of the time window, same forms as since.
until.title: Until
